title: Restore native Case Queue page when returning from authorized Case Workspace
goal: Allow a Case on a nonfirst native HTTP Queue page to open the already existing Case Workspace and safely restore its same authorized page, filters, scroll and selection on return.
invariants: A paged Case handoff is allowed only if selected Case belongs to the current fully authorized and filtered Queue page; original unpaged Case handoff remains unchanged.
Both GET Case open and POST Queue return re-authorize the current Case/Incident/Finding owner graph and current trusted Shared Saved View; page cursor is presentation state, not authorization.
Restore must fail closed if selected page is stale, tampered, hidden, changed or Case ACL revoked, and return no partial Case or source info.
The existing ProjectWithSavedViewFallback, OpenCaseWorkspace/RestoreCaseQueue, pagination helper are reused; no new search/permission/persistence engine.
security_properties: A cursor cannot select a Case outside its present authorized page.
Second-page return rechecks current authorized list and original cursor digest before exposing state.
Invalid query controls rejected before the session provider; returned opaque token never includes raw source previews.

migration.rationale: Backward compatible optional native Queue page navigation fields; no stored object mutation.

rollback.strategy: Revert opt-in page-context open/restore extension and keep already working read-only pagination and unpaged Case handoff.

inputs: CAP-INV-101 §§17/25 requires restored filter/scroll/selection on return from Case Workspace.
Existing parent #144 implementation of limit/cursor refuses `open_case` on paginated Queue; subsequent return token stores no page position.
Parent PR #144 immutable SHA 5051c7e1b9444fc5e35e818c9fabffe4f9ccda2c exact-head CI 39301206887 SUCCESS; L2 pending/inaccessible and parent DRAFT.
outputs: Native GET with limit+cursor+open_case returns existing WorkspaceHandoff only for selected Case on that authorized page.
Native POST return includes current page context (limit/cursor) and rejects stale projection or ACL changes.
Prior unpaged GET/open/return and cursor paging preserved.
acceptance_tests: Go httptest: first page and second page; open Case C from second page, POST returns exactly same Case, scroll, sort, page size/cursor with independent current authorization on both calls.
Opening Case C from first page or Case A with second-page cursor denied; source ACL revocation or changed Case projection prevents stale page restore.
Malformed/forged/tenant-injecting and duplicated query controls fail closed before provider; original Queue and Workspace behavior remain green.
Exact-head engineering-kernel mandatory 90% changed-security floor and independent read-only L2 are required; no merge until approvals.

performance_budget.rationale: Reuse the already existing <=5000 candidate authorization and projection pipeline, including current page fingerprint; no durable cross-request snapshot or new index.
metrics: Full Case candidate and nested ACLs per request
Current one existing projection, an additional page fingerprint for navigation/return
